full_submitted_prompt_and_sha256.prompt: A text-free full-frame 16:9 matte mixed-media psychological collage with paper-like tactile grain, dry painterly and sculptural traces, subtle erosion, restrained blur, and clear low-saturation figure-ground separation. One sparse eroded sculptural human silhouette as the sole subject. Palette strictly dusty peach, mauve, lavender, pale blue, cream, charcoal, and warm gray, with a single restrained ember-orange accent. Matte only — no gloss, no wet impasto, no photorealism, no neon, no crowding, no typography, no logo, no watermark.

no_reference_or_compositing_declaration.statement: Pure single-pass text-to-image from the approved prompt alone. The collage appearance is rendered by the model; no actual compositing, layering, or masking was performed. The only post-generation operation is the deterministic whole-image WebP conversion recorded below.

untouched_original_raster.note: Retained unmodified outside the repository as the returned original.

conversion.recipe: sharp resize(1672x941, fit:fill, kernel:lanczos3) then webp({lossless:true, effort:6})
conversion.upscale_disclosure: The returned original is 1280x720 (GPT Image 2 1K 16:9, the only size the app's preview path requests). The whole-image conversion to the 1672x941 family standard is therefore a 1.306x upscale. No crop or reframing.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: One completely original text-free full-frame 16:9 raster suitable for deterministic whole-image conversion to 1672x941 WebP.
acceptance_contract_assessment.note: Text-free, 16:9 full-frame, single-pass original; conversion verified deterministic. 1.306x upscale disclosed above.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: The medium is a matte mixed-media psychological collage with paper-like tactile grain, dry painterly and sculptural traces, subtle erosion, restrained blur, and clear low-saturation figure-ground separation.
acceptance_contract_assessment.note: Decisively matte torn-paper collage: visible paper grain and torn edges, dry painterly and eroded plaster passages across neck and shoulder, low saturation, dark figure separating cleanly from the pale ground. This is the exact axis on which the 1.0.0 candidate failed, and it is unambiguously satisfied here.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: The palette is limited to dusty peach, mauve, lavender, pale blue, cream, charcoal, and warm gray, with ember orange only as a restrained accent.
acceptance_contract_assessment.note: All seven named colours present; ember orange confined to a single small patch on the head.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: The composition contains one sparse fragmented or eroded portrait, mask, mannequin, silhouette, door, flame, sculptural human trace, or abstract emotional object.
acceptance_contract_assessment.note: One eroded human silhouette as the sole subject.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: Glossy CGI, wet or heavy impasto, photoreal stock imagery, neon color, crowded scenes, typography, copied trade dress, malformed anatomy or text, logos, and watermarks are rejected.
acceptance_contract_assessment.note: No gloss, no impasto, no photorealism, no neon, not crowded, no typography, no logos or watermarks; anatomy reads cleanly.

acceptance_contract_assessment.criterion: No reference or saved image, Editorial source, image edit, compositing, masking, title plate, post-render overlay, logo, watermark, or UI is permitted.
